paragraphs: AccessE11 sells software that helps municipalities manage citizen issues, service requests, outbound communications and community feedback. The company describes its buyers as small to medium sized municipal customers.

Residents reach the system through a suite of publicly accessible web portals. Staff answer back through email and SMS messaging tools built for two way communication. The application is cloud based, with a mobile app so staff can work anywhere they have an internet connection. GIS integration adds a map view that shows hot spots of issues across the community.

The customers page says the software has been operational since 2014. It is used daily by municipalities and local governments to manage their interactions with citizens. Published use cases include South Stormont, a township in eastern Ontario with a population of 13,110. The site lists a mailing address in Ottawa, Ontario.

quote.text: AccessE11 creates an effective digital connection between municipal staff and the residents they serve.
